top_events.title: High-speed train crash kills at least 68 people in Spain
top_events.label: Spain train crash kills 68 near Madrid
top_events.summary: Two high-speed trains collided south of Madrid, killing at least 68 and injuring over 100 in the deadliest Spanish rail disaster in over a decade. The crash affects EU transport safety perception.

top_events.title: Netanyahu's bloc leading Israel election but short of majority, partial results show
top_events.label: Netanyahu leads Israel vote without majority
top_events.summary: With 85% counted, Netanyahu's bloc has 53 seats in the 120-seat Knesset, pointing to continued deadlock. No direct impact on Poland; ongoing Middle East political situation.

top_events.title: Serbian shot dead after attacking officer outside Israeli embassy, minister says
top_events.label: Attacker shot dead at Israeli embassy Belgrade
top_events.summary: An underage male attacked an officer outside the Israeli embassy in Belgrade and was killed. Regional security incident in a Balkan neighbor, no direct Polish impact.
